verdict.rationale: LM Studio's Bionic agent can be directed in natural language, by text or real-time voice, to create and edit documents and run agentic tasks, and a hands-on user says it 'works great'. However, there is no evidence that LM Studio's own operations, such as loading or unloading models, starting the server or changing configuration, can be driven by natural-language commands; those are documented as GUI actions or `lms` CLI flags. Missing for 10: natural-language control of the product's own model, server and configuration management; documentation of what Bionic can operate beyond documents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Talk to Bionic naturally, and your speech gets transcribed in real time.
Work with Bionic to create and edit documents. Every change is automatically saved, so you can work with your agent freely.
use them for simple chats or advanced agentic tasks.
I gave Bionic a shot immediately. First impression: it works great
